name: atlabs-dev-skills
description: Claude Code plugins for software teams, built and run in production at Atlabs.

plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: Multi-agent PR review: 6 specialist reviewers in parallel, including a behavior-parity reviewer that compares old and new code, a validator that re-reads the code behind every finding (dedupes, scores confidence, checks the suggested fix), and an impact analyst that maps which existing flows the change could break.

plugins.name: pr-band
plugins.description: Shows the current branch's pull request above the prompt: number, title, +/- lines and a CI status dot, with a hover card and refresh. Needs the GitHub CLI.
